objective: Integrate, test, package and locally merge Gate 3 deliverables and optional Agent Efficiency capability into CouncilFlow main under the current Owner request.

source_provenance.description: The full Owner request is visible in inherited conversation context. Acceptance text below is Planner-generated traceability, not a verbatim Owner AC fixture. No independently byte-exported host message is claimed; historical Gate 3 originals remain authoritative for their own criteria.

acceptance.text: Create an integration branch from verified current local main; import feature/agent-efficiency through Git history; selectively import Gate 3 application/tests and approved sanitized regression assets; preserve original branches, commits, Gate 3 worktree/evidence, frozen specifications, approved fixtures, backups, role definitions and unrelated files.

acceptance.text: Maintain Gate 3 CSV column-sum demo with Decimal summation, positional CLI, clean errors and nonzero failures; retain deterministic behavior tests and add only missing focused handoff/criteria-fidelity regression controls.
acceptance.verification: Demo tests, original Gate 3 acceptance tests, contracts/source-fidelity negative controls

acceptance.text: Package existing Python recorder, digest/expand, Codex adapter and Claude Code/xKiro adapter as a usable explicitly activated optional skill capability; one maintained runtime copy, relocatable in other compatible repositories, documented small CLI interface, retained full permitted command-output artifacts and existing failure/timeout/incomplete safeguards.
acceptance.verification: Original toolkit suites plus extracted and relocated CLI tests, opt-in instruction checks

acceptance.text: Preserve native Codex workflow and distinct Worker, Tester, Reviewer, Manager and Planner responsibilities, original-source fidelity, independent verification and Reviewer deterministic rerun; Owner performs no routine courier work; efficiency cannot replace roles or suppress critical evidence; disabled efficiency preserves normal workflow.
acceptance.verification: Unmodified role policy/native definitions where possible, existing workflow contracts, focused opt-in/fidelity controls, independent Tester/Reviewer evidence

acceptance.text: Update README, RELEASE, skill references, package tests and release allowlist to include maintained demo, required runtime/references/tests; preserve deterministic ZIP, safe paths/link protections/exclusions; produce dist/council-flow.zip, manifest and SHA-256; verify CRC/source bytes/installability and all applicable suites after extraction without original checkout.
acceptance.verification: Builder tests, archive inventory/hash/source-byte comparison, separate temporary extraction and relocated install execution

acceptance.text: Keep historical Gate 3 NATIVE_ROLE_WORKFLOW_PARTIAL separate from release verification: seven E-checks passed; E1/E2/E4 remain UNVERIFIED. Offline adapter verification is not live compatibility proof; Codex/Claude Code/xKiro live remains unverified; no billing/cache/upstream/quota claims, paid/live trials, formal Gate 3 rerun, global hooks/private interception, server/router/orchestrator, universal selector implementation, or Package D trials. Package D remains DRAFT_NOT_AUTHORIZED.
acceptance.verification: Documentation review, runtime import/source review, historical frozen-byte comparison, scope diff

acceptance.text: After successful implementation and independent verification, commit dedicated integration branch, preserve previous main as recoverable reference, merge ordinarily into local main, rebuild and rerun relevant regression/extracted-release verification on main; no reset/clean/force/push. Report invocation, features, evidence, final main hash, ZIP/SHA, limitations and publication readiness.
acceptance.source_location: Owner section 7, definition of done and final report
acceptance.verification: Commit ancestry, backup ref, final main status, final build and verification records

units.deliverable: Verify Git state, create integration from local main, merge feature history, snapshot preservation/oracle identities before Worker.

Inspect existing code; select minimal Gate 3 application/tests/sanitized fixture import; relocate functional toolkit runtime/tests into installable skill with no diverging copy; retain Package D draft outside active runtime.

Add explicit CLI/reference, relocation and packaging regression tests; update README/RELEASE/skill references/release allowlist; run developer suites and build; freeze candidate manifest then stop edits.

Independently verify exact candidate against original request/plan, pristine oracles, all relevant suites, archive bytes/extraction/relocation; record exact executable, arguments, workdir, input/candidate hashes, exit and normalized stdout hash.
Compare original request/plan, candidate, Tester evidence and preserved sources; independently rerun a Tester-declared deterministic command with CRLF-to-LF-only stdout normalization.
Manager evaluates both reports; original Planner checks original acceptance; Manager commits/ordinary-merges and rebuilds/verifies final main, reports remaining limitations.

dependencies: One mutating Worker; independent Tester and Reviewer never repair product. Rework uses fresh Worker under unchanged acceptance.
verification_strategy: Manager snapshots existing tests, frozen Gate 3 specifications/approved fixture identities, role definitions and original Gate 3 app/tests before Worker; Worker tests supplement rather than replace.

Run python -m unittest discover -s tests -v and each maintained demo/report verification suite listed in RELEASE; exclude intentionally failing starter fixture and separately label historical restoration suites.
Run all existing recorder, digest/expand, Codex adapter, Claude adapter and evaluate offline tests from their maintained relocated paths; retain sanitized fixtures only.
Test exact Gate 3 positional CLI success/error behaviors with fresh process; verify Decimal precision behavior and failure exits.

Build python tools/build_release.py; validate ZIP CRC, safe inventory, exact source bytes/manifest/checksum and deterministic rebuild; reject excluded artifacts/secrets/links through existing and focused tests.

Extract to separate temporary directory; execute applicable full suites and explicit recorder/digest/expand/adapters from extracted skill, then copy only installable skill/native roles to unrelated repository and verify CLI works without development path.

Tester selects deterministic stdout command (for example Gate 3 CSV invocation against packaged sample) and records exact executable path plus inputs; Reviewer independently repeats and compares exit and SHA-256 after CRLF-to-LF replacement only.
After merge repeat build and relevant tests on local main; current Windows-local evidence stays separate from historical experiment or Cloud claims.
risks: Existing toolkit path assumptions/imports may require relocation updates; no duplicate runtime.
Git author identity was absent; Manager used per-command Codex identity for local history merge without global configuration.
Gate 3 worktree contains untracked evidence; do not modify or indiscriminately import.
Current host exact backend model identifier is unavailable; do not infer one.
No live hook/adapter compatibility, token savings, native Gate3 telemetry completeness or billing proof is established by offline tests.
